---
title: Custom TOC component
toc-component: toc.tsx
---

This page binds the table of contents to `toc.tsx` through
`toc-component:` (bd-toc-scrollspy-js-41e624d8). Without JavaScript the
nav shows the static list; with it, the component renders its own list
from `props.entries` and tracks the current section itself. Hand check:
`q2 preview --static` on this directory, then scroll.
